description: List contacts in the Keap CRM. Supports filtering, ordering, field selection, and cursor pagination (page_size / page_token). Keap: GET /contacts.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (field selection).

filter.description: Filter expression, e.g. `given_name==John` (see Keap REST v2 filtering).

order_by.description: Field to order results by, e.g. `given_name` or `-date_created`.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response's next_page_token.

name: keap_list_contacts
title: List contacts
